description: Wallet balance observations that decide whether a surplus lot is scheduled. Floor interactions are financial: scheduling the whole deposit would sweep money the user keeps, and scheduling below-floor refills would sweep the floor.

cases.name: first observation schedules balance above floor
first observation at or below floor schedules nothing
target without a configured floor never schedules
deposit fully below floor schedules nothing
deposit that only refills a drawdown schedules only the new surplus
deposit entirely above the floor schedules the full delta
zero or negative delta is never schedulable
